# Snake for the ZX Spectrum

Snake, a port of the classic Snake/Tron game to the ZX Spectrum 48K,
written in C with z88dk by David Crespo (2020, MIT licence: LICENSE),
from https://github.com/dcrespo3d/zx-spectrum-snake (release 1.01,
`snake-1.01.tap`, SHA-256
f5ee2da8041b05d6ecd13edc0bdc74dab8c7b60fec8154114dcd4e7807c9dbc5),
unchanged. Played in MyNOS by the package zxspectrum: type `zxsnake`.
(MyNOS has a `snake` package of its own, in OCaml; this is the
Spectrum's.)

For one player. On the menu, keys 1 to 9 choose the speed (1 slow, 9
fast), Enter starts. W A S D move the snake; P pauses. Eat the green
food, do not hit the walls or yourself.
